name: M7.LabelReplay.trace_recover
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) (d : ℕ) (P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N)) (xs : List (Fin (2*N))), (M7.LabelReplay.endpoint P (M7.LabelReplay.trace c d P xs), M7.LabelReplay.queryCount (M7.LabelReplay.trace c d P xs)) = M6.Pinned.recover (fun P => (M7.LabelReplay.Q c P).coeff d) P xs
guidance: Induct xs generalizing P. trace calls the exact existing Pinned.choose, as does recover. The endpoint foldl uses the recorded after state and the queryCount list sum uses that same chosen step query count. Rewrite the induction hypothesis on next.1. Preassigned pins are included (step queries0), no correctness oracle required. Return tactic lines without leading by.
